name: Perseus Cluster, ultra-diffuse galaxy field UDG07 (Hubble)
blurb: A field of ultra-diffuse galaxies in the Perseus Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: perseusudg07-hubble
story: This outlying field of the Perseus Cluster was chosen for its ultra-diffuse galaxies, faint, spread-out systems that still puzzle astronomers. Are they failed galaxies with high masses, or a mixed bag?

claims.text: The Perseus cluster is also known as Abell 426
Ten outlying fields of the program target known ultra-diffuse galaxies in Perseus
The PERSEUS-UDG07 field contains WUDG01, WUDG02, WUDG07 and RUDG015
The open question about UDGs: failed underluminous galaxies with high masses, or a mixed bag
